title: Violet Cottage
description:
My guest room is perfect for the quiet professional, single visitor, and Nature lover. The room has a closet, a kitchenette with fridge/freezer/microvwave/Keurig. It can squeeze two with the trundle bed. The shared bathroom has a deep tub and rain shower. Quiet neighborhood, top-notch coffee/restaurants within walking distance, easy access to public transit, fast ride-shares for exploring. Violet Cottage is a 1920s Craftsman guests call "whimsical and cozy", shared with me and Sylvester my cat.

During your stay
I'm happy to chat with my guests, or give them space. I'll do my best to read your cues, but also feel free to let me know what you prefer. Raised in Nashville, I can give solid recommendations on most things, or point you where to find the answer.

Other things to note
Sylvester the tuxedo cat does not go in the room, but is around in case you have allergies.
